components.css: .ds-outlined{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji";font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.75;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:transparent;color:#007AFF;border:1px solid rgba(0,122,255,.5);padding:5px 15px;}.ds-outlined:hover{background:rgba(0,122,255,.04);border-color:#007AFF;}.ds-outlined:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:none}.ds-outlined:active{box-shadow:none}

components.name: Named VPN selector
components.description: Small outlined field. Selection remains a draft until saved.
components.css: .ds-field{position:relative;display:block;width:260px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji";color:#000}.ds-field span{position:absolute;left:10px;top:-8px;padding:0 4px;background:#ECECEC;font-size:12px;color:#3C3C4399}.ds-field select{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:16px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.23);border-radius:4px;padding:8.5px 14px;color:inherit}.ds-field select:hover{border-color:#000}.ds-field select:focus-visible{outline:none;border:2px solid #007AFF;padding:7.5px 13px}

narrative.northStar: Existing Clash Verge Rev desktop utility
narrative.overview: G Verge retains the existing Clash Verge Rev desktop world. The owner chose the name and asked to simplify the existing MUI application. No separate creative metaphor or replacement visual identity is established.
keyCharacteristics: Native system typography with inherited MUI controls.
Flat sections with explicit state messages.

rules.name: Theme source rule
rules.body: Native light/dark colors come from _theme.tsx. In system mode Tauri reads the OS theme and listens for changes; the native window follows the OS.

dos: Do reuse the actual MUI theme and existing shell components.
Do show a named VPN separately from its country or connection.
Do explain inactive routing and unsaved changes in readable Russian.
Do retain native light, dark and system behavior.
donts: Don't promote the preview harness into native visual authority.
Don't expose profiles, scripts or merge configuration in ordinary navigation.
Don't show DIRECT/REJECT identifiers as ordinary choices.
Don't claim a changed selector is already saved or active.
Don't add a replacement identity or decorative card system during this simplification.
